name: The Last Lantern
premise: A bridge-town lighthouse went dark. Decide whom to trust before the river fog arrives.

mira.name: Mira
experience: Maintained river lamps for twelve years
Knows bridge toll routines, not hidden court affairs
mira.intent: Keep the town safe without surrendering her family workshop

goals: Investigate the central mystery without losing your companions

events.title: An arrival
events.description: A rope-tied skiff reaches the quay.

events.title: A distant complication
events.description: An unseen faction begins looking for the same answer.

canon.title: The Last Lantern setting notes
canon.text: The bridge tollkeeper keeps a copper key. The old lighthouse has no keeper tonight.
